notes: Printing fixes. A short shopping list printed across two pages — three items would put the third on a sheet of its own — and short lists were split down the middle into two columns, which read like a mistake. Lists now stay in one column until they're long enough to need two, and never cost an extra sheet. Recipe quantities like ⅘ cup also came out blank, because the print font doesn't carry the less common fractions; those are now written out as 4/5.
